summary:
Iter 121 focused on FRONTEND verification of (A) the new warehouse logic and (B) the manager showcase/cabinet. Setup/cleanup performed via admin API (temp manager TEST_UIMgr, temp client TEST_UIClient bound to him with 10% personal discount, temp TEST_UI product with stock=5, min_price=950, purchase_price=600). The main agent's backend pytest suite (test_iter121/122) is already green; this run did NOT rerun it.

Result: Almost everything works. One real bug was found (Repeat Order loses the draft) plus one minor UX note (sidebar 'Склад' badge).

Showcase — PASS: header shows manager-cabinet-link + manager-showcase-header-link; cabinet shows manager-showcase-link. /manager/showcase renders showcase-grid with showcase-item-<id>, showcase-stock ("В наличии: 5 шт. · Москва"), showcase-commission ("Ваш доход: +40 ₽"), showcase-min-price ("Мин. цена: 950 ₽"). GET /api/manager/products and /api/manager/products/<id> both exclude purchase_price. Body text search finds no закупочная/закупка wording anywhere on the showcase pages. Search by article, by 'масляный <sfx>' (two words, any order) and nonsense→showcase-empty all work; showcase-count updates. Filters showcase-manufacturer, showcase-in-stock, showcase-sort (price_desc etc.) work. showcase-view-list renders showcase-list; preference persists across reload. Picking client in showcase-client renders showcase-client-price-<id> = 'Клиенту: 950 ₽' (1000 − 10% = 900 was floored to min_price 950, as spec'd).

Product page — PASS: showcase-open-<id> navigates to /manager/showcase/<id> → manager-product-page with manager-product-name, manager-product-description, manager-product-crosses, manager-product-stock, manager-product-back. Unknown id → manager-product-missing.

Draft (showcase side) — PASS: showcase-add-<id> adds to a shared draft, showcase-draft-bar appears and survives page reload, showcase-go-order navigates to /manager?tab=catalog where manager-order-draft contains the items and manager-order-client is preselected to the client picked on the showcase.

Selection to chat — PASS: manager-send-selection posts the list; toast 'Подборка из 1 поз. отправлена клиенту в чат'; GET /api/manager/chats last_text starts with 'Подборка для вас:\n1. TEST_UI Фильтр масляный … × 950.00 ₽ в наличии\nИтого: 950.00 ₽'.

Tasks — PASS: adding a task with past due date shows manager-tasks-overdue=1 on the Задачи tab.

Manager restrictions — PASS: /admin as manager redirects to /manager.

Admin warehouse (/admin?tab=warehouse) — PASS: stock-check-card + stock-check-status 'Расхождений нет', default-min-card + default-min-input (value 5), wh-stat-low, wh-only-low all render. Per-product input wh-min-<pid> is accepted, persists after reload (10). Sidebar 'Склад' shows a numeric badge (observed '7' after setting our product's min to 10). Overview tab (tab=overview) shows 'Требует внимания' + 'Товары заканчиваются' block (needs ~10s to load — slow). Inventory tab: inventory-warehouse select present, typing inventory-actual-<pid>=9 shows inventory-diff-<pid>='+4'; inventory-submit books it; stock-tab row shows 9 immediately after returning to stock tab. Movements chips mv-filter-all/receipt/writeoff/sale/transfer/inventory/return/cancel/adjustment all render. Movements for our pid logged: sale, sale, inventory, adjustment (via API GET /api/admin/warehouse/movements).

Sell only from stock — PASS: as client, trying to add 100 of a 9-in-stock product fires red toast «TEST_UI Фильтр масляный …»: в наличии только 9 шт.' and cart stays empty (/api/cart items=[]).

ui_bugs.issue: Repeat Order resets the draft to empty instead of filling it. Observed: after clicking manager-order-repeat-<id>, cabinet switches to the catalog tab and toast 'Товары перенесены в новый заказ' appears, but manager-order-draft stays empty ('Добавьте товары кнопкой «+» …') and manager-order-client is NOT preselected. Root cause: useManagerDraft stores state in a per-component useState and only writes to localStorage inside useEffect. repeat() calls draft.replace(items, o.user_id) and synchronously calls onRepeat() → setTab('catalog'); React commits both state updates in one batch, ManagerOrdersTab unmounts, so the pending useEffect for its draft state never runs. ManagerCatalogTab mounts, its useState initializer reads the still-empty localStorage, then its own useEffect writes the empty default ({'items':[],'clientId':''}). Confirmed by inspecting localStorage.getItem('manager_draft') right after the click. Fix: write to localStorage synchronously inside the draft setters (add/replace/clear/setClientId) instead of via useEffect, or move the draft into a module-level store / React context so both tabs share one state instance.

issues: First paint of the admin overview tab is slow — content block 'Требует внимания'/'Товары заканчиваются' only appears after ~10 s. During those 10 s only 'Загрузка…' is visible. Not a bug, but UX-slow.

Spec says the red counter should equal the number of low-stock products. After setting min=10 for our TEST_UI product (stock=9 → should be low) the badge still read '7' while wh-stat-low on the warehouse tab read '8'. Likely a stale/cached count on the sidebar — either the sidebar isn't refreshing on min-stock change, or it is debounced to the 15 s auto-refresh. Minor; the warehouse page itself is correct.

action_items: Fix Repeat Order in ManagerOrdersTab: make useManagerDraft persist synchronously (e.g. write localStorage inside each setter) OR share the draft across tabs via context/module store, so the state update survives the immediate setTab('catalog') that unmounts ManagerOrdersTab.
(optional) Refresh the sidebar 'Склад' red counter on min-stock/stock changes without waiting for the 15 s poll.
(optional) Add a loading skeleton for /admin?tab=overview — currently only 'Загрузка…' for ~10 s.
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/managerDraft.js — each useManagerDraft() instance has its own useState and only syncs via a useEffect that writes localStorage after commit; two sibling consumers do not share state, and any setState immediately followed by an unmount loses the write (exact scenario in ManagerOrdersTab.repeat → setTab('catalog')). Prefer a single source of truth (Zustand/useSyncExternalStore or a context) or at minimum write localStorage synchronously in the setters.
src/components/staff/ManagerSales.js:42 — repeat() depends on the above and is therefore effectively broken for the primary success path.
GET /api/manager/products and /api/manager/products/<id> correctly omit purchase_price in all cases checked. No leakage via /manager/showcase UI.
AdminWarehousePage initial payload is heavy enough that the first paint of /admin?tab=overview takes ~10 s on the preview URL. Consider splitting the overview API or paginating.
AuthHeader sidebar 'Склад' badge computation appears to come from a separate endpoint than wh-stat-low — they disagreed by one after an online change (8 vs 7). Worth aligning to the same source.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md as instructed. Admin password pulled from env ADMIN_PASSWORD (never printed). Created a temp manager (TEST_UIMgr, mgrpass123) and a temp client (TEST_UIClient, password123) — both deleted at the end.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted: TEST_UI product (name 'TEST_UI Фильтр масляный <sfx>', article TEST-UI-<sfx>, price 1000, purchase 600, min 950, stock 5); temp manager account; temp client account. Two manager-side orders were placed on the temp client to test repeat-order — they belong to the temp client that was deleted, and are no longer visible. Default minimum stock (5) and per-product minimum stocks on real products were NOT touched. Only our TEST_UI product's min-stock was set (10 then 0) during testing; the product itself was deleted at the end, so nothing persists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Repeat Order is the only outstanding frontend bug from this request. Reproduction: as a manager with at least one past order for a bound client, open /manager?tab=orders → expand the order → click 'Повторить заказ'. Expected: catalog tab opens with items in manager-order-draft and the client preselected. Actual: catalog tab opens but draft is empty and client unselected. localStorage key 'manager_draft' ends up as {'items':[],'clientId':''}. Fix lives in /app/frontend/src/lib/managerDraft.js. Everything else (showcase search/sort/filter/view switch/client price/product page, selection→chat, tasks, warehouse stock card, default min, per-product min, inventory, movements chips, sell-only-from-stock toast, manager restrictions, no purchase_price leak) is working.
rca of the issue: Repeat Order: useManagerDraft persists state only via useEffect(() => localStorage.setItem(...)). repeat() calls draft.replace(items, clientId) and immediately calls onRepeat() → setTab('catalog'). React batches both setState calls; on commit, ManagerOrdersTab unmounts before its useEffect can write to localStorage, so the just-replaced items/clientId are lost. ManagerCatalogTab mounts, its own useState initializer reads the still-empty localStorage, and its useEffect then overwrites localStorage with the empty default. Mitigation: synchronously persist inside the setters, or hoist the draft state to a shared store / context so both tabs read the same instance.
